name: tx.origin Authorization Bypass
threat_model: An owner EOA is tricked into calling an attacker-controlled contract, which forwards a privileged withdrawal while tx.origin still names the owner.
assumptions: The owner is an EOA that can be induced to call an untrusted contract.
The vulnerable authorization check uses tx.origin.
The demonstration measures an ETH withdrawal and does not model phishing delivery.
invariant: Only the immediate authorized owner caller can perform a privileged withdrawal.

detector_expectations.expectation: expected on VulnerableAccess; absent from SafeAccess
